# Coding standards — nrscholar-frontend

Web: React 18 · TypeScript 5.6 · Vite 5 · Tailwind 3 · React Router 7 · i18next · framer-motion · three.js.
Mobile: Expo 54 · expo-router · React Native 0.81 · React 19 · Zustand.
Tags: **[Preserve]** = existing convention, **[Standard]** = required for new and changed code,
**[Avoid]** = anti-pattern, never add more.

## Formatting

- **[Preserve]** There's no Prettier config. Match the existing code: 2 spaces, **double quotes**, semicolons. Don't reformat lines you didn't change.
- **[Standard]** Import order: React → external packages → app modules (`../api`, components) → assets/styles. No unused imports.

## TypeScript

- **[Standard] No new `any`.** The lint rule is off, so this is on you. Type API responses (`interface UserMeResponse { success: boolean; message?: string; data: … }`), props and state. Use `unknown` + narrowing in `catch`.
- **[Standard]** Shared types for a feature live in `src/features/<feature>/types.ts`. Don't repeat inline shapes across screens.
- **[Avoid]** `as any`, `!` on `localStorage`/`JSON.parse` results, empty `catch (e) {}` without a comment explaining why ignoring is safe.

## Naming

- **[Preserve] Screens:** `src/features/<feature>/pages/<Name>Screen.tsx` with `export default function <Name>Screen()`. Shared components: `PascalCase.tsx`.
- **[Preserve] Mobile routes:** expo-router file names in `mobile/app/` are kebab-case (`weekly-test-results.tsx`). Components are PascalCase. Hooks are `useX.ts`.
- **[Standard] Full words.** ❌ `u`, `e`, `res`, `json`, `t2`, `tmp`, single-letter callback params. ✅ `user`, `error`, `response`, `payload`. (`t` from `useTranslation` is fine.)
- **[Standard]** Booleans `is/has/can/should…`. Handlers `handleX`, callback props `onX`. Constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.
- **[Avoid]** Misspelled file names like the mobile `reward_mathchampaign.tsx` / `rewardscreen_legenderybot.tsx`. New files use correct, kebab-case names.

## Constants, not strings

- **[Standard]** Storage keys (`"userToken"`, `"userData"`, …), route paths, event names (`"force-logout"`), statuses and roles used in logic are constants (for example `src/constants/storage-keys.ts`, `src/constants/routes.ts`, created on first need). Don't add new string literals for them.
- Brand values come from `src/config.ts` (`APP_CONFIG`).

## Components

- **[Standard]** Keep files under ~400 lines. Many legacy screens are 500–1,350 lines, so don't grow them. Put new logic in a hook (`src/features/<feature>/hooks/useX.ts`), sub-component (`src/features/<feature>/components/`) or helper.
- Order inside a component: hooks (router, translation) → state → derived values → handlers → effects → early returns → JSX.
- **[Avoid]** Components defined inside components, index keys on dynamic lists, effects without cleanup for timers, listeners, intervals and animation frames.

## Errors

- **[Standard]** Every request shows a loading state and a friendly, translated error state (and retry where it makes sense). `apiFetch` returns a fake `503` response on network failure, so check `response.ok` / `success`.
- **[Preserve]** Auth expiry is handled centrally (`clearAuthSession` + the `force-logout` event). Don't duplicate it per screen.
- **[Avoid]** `console.log` (only `console.warn`/`console.error` for unexpected states). Showing raw error messages to children.

## Comments

Explain *why*, not *what*. No commented-out code. No owner-less `TODO`.
